name: fig17_greybody_factors
caption: Transmission probabilities obtained by integrating the radial wave equation from the horizon (pure ingoing wave) to a large radius and decomposing into Riccati-Hankel waves. All values lie in [0, 1] and Wronskian flux conservation holds to 1e-09 (relative to the incident flux). Low multipoles transmit well above y ~ 0.3 while high multipoles are suppressed by the centrifugal barrier. Spin-1 and spin-2 fields have a stronger barrier at the same l.
